parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format in UTC.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The metric type. Valid values:

- `all`

- `train`

- `eval`

> The default value is *all*.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the query result.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of records to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

The default value is 100.

parameters.name: RelativeDBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated PolarDB instance.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description: Specifies whether to sort the results in reverse order. The default value is *false*.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format in UTC.
